sentences.text:
1
 Sk, J
 W.P.No.23270 of 2018
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice K.Sarath
 W.P.No.23270 of 2018
Order:

This writ petition is filed seeking to declare the action of the respondents in interfering with the peaceful possession and enjoyment of petitioner's agricultural land in Sy.No.112 (Old), Sy.No.98 (New) to an extent of Ac.0.60 gts situated at Kannala Lakshmipur Village, Bellampally Mandal,
Mancherial District (Old Adilabad District) without notice and without following due process of law as illegal and arbitrary.

2. This Court, while admitting the writ petition on 06.07.2018, granted interim order directing the respondents not to interfere with the possession and enjoyment of the petitioner over the subject property without following due process of law.
However, in spite of lapse of more than 7 years, the respondents did not choose to file counter or vacate petition denying the averments made by the petitioners.
In view of the same, the Writ Petition is disposed of directing the respondents not to interfere with the possession of the petitioner over the subject property without following due process of law.

However, if the respondents want to acquire the land of the petitioner, they shall follow due procedure under Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
